init_sawyer_hammer_env: create a SawyerHammerEnvV2 instance to initialize the Meta-World hammer task environment with default config
evaluate_state_reward: evaluate the SawyerHammerEnvV2 state by calling evaluate_state with obs and action to get reward and info
compute_hammer_reward: compute the hammer task reward by calling compute_reward with actions and observation to get grasp and position rewards
reset_hammer_model: reset the SawyerHammerEnvV2 model by calling reset_model to randomize hammer position and return initial observation
set_hammer_position: set the hammer XYZ position in the simulation by calling _set_hammer_xyz with a position array
